name: f4chan
description: Browse the catalogue of any 4chan board and fetch any available thread. Returns formatted markdown with OP content, reply excerpts, and image links.

params.name: action
params.description: 'catalog' to list threads on a board page (optionally filtered by search), or 'thread' to fetch a specific thread (optionally filtered by search)

params.name: page
params.description: Catalog page number (default 1, ignored when action is 'thread' or when search is provided)

params.name: search
params.description: Search term. When action is 'catalog', fetches the full catalog (/{board}/catalog.json — one API call) and returns only threads whose subject or comment matches. When action is 'thread', returns only replies whose comment matches.

params.name: offset
params.description: Skip this many replies (thread only, default 0)

params.name: limit
params.description: Max replies to return (thread only, default 50, max 100)
